course.title: Bootstrap — Complete Practical Course
course.description: A practical Bootstrap course covering responsive layout, utilities, components, forms, interactive components, customization, accessibility, production patterns and real learning-platform projects.
learningOutcomes: Create responsive forms and interactive components.

modules.description: Learn bootstrap foundations through detailed explanations, realistic examples and dedicated tasks.

lessons.title: What Is Bootstrap?
lessons.description: Understand Bootstrap as a responsive front-end toolkit and learn the roles of its CSS utilities, components and JavaScript plugins.

Bootstrap Course

items: Run the example in your browser.
